[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question, choose Numeric, and set the range the answer may take.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen with the number question selected and its settings panel outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/numeric-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The number question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/numeric-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Minimum and maximum.** The accepted range. A respondent whose entry is outside it is asked to correct it.

## Best practices for research

Name the unit in the question, such as nights or years, so every respondent answers on the same scale.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
